definition: if something tends to happen, it happens often and is likely to happen again (tend + to-infinitive)
translation: có xu hướng làm gì, thường hay làm gì
exampleSentence: People tend to need less sleep as they get older.
exampleTranslation: Con người có xu hướng cần ngủ ít hơn khi già đi.

definition: to say that you will cause someone harm or trouble if they do not do what you want (threaten + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: He threatened to take them to court.
exampleTranslation: Ông ta đe dọa sẽ kiện họ ra tòa.

definition: to offer to do something without expecting a reward (volunteer + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Helen volunteered to have Thanksgiving at her house this year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nay Helen tình nguyện tổ chức lễ Tạ ơn ở nhà mình.

definition: to stay somewhere or not do something until something else happens (wait + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Are you waiting to use the phone?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đang chờ để dùng điện thoại à?

definition: to have a wish to do something (want + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I want to learn how to swim.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn học bơi.

definition: to ask someone firmly to do something for you (want + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I want you to find out what they're planning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn bạn tìm hiểu xem họ đang lên kế hoạch gì.

definition: to want to do something; formal (wish + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I wish to make a complaint.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn khiếu nại.

definition: used to say politely that you want to do something (would like + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I'd like to see that film.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn xem bộ phim đó.

definition: used to say politely that you want someone to do something (would like + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: He would like us all to be at the meeting.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy muốn tất cả chúng ta có mặt trong cuộc họp.

definition: used to say that you very much want to do something (would love + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I'd love to know why they did that.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất muốn biết tại sao họ làm vậy.

definition: used to say that someone should do something because it is the best or most sensible thing (ought + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: You really ought to quit smoking.
exampleTranslation: Bạn thực sự nên bỏ thuốc lá.

definition: to stop doing something or stop happening; formal (cease + to-infinitive)
translation: không còn làm gì nữa, ngừng làm gì
exampleSentence: He ceased to be a member of the association.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy không còn là thành viên của hiệp hội nữa.

definition: to stop doing something; formal (cease + -ing)
exampleSentence: The company decided to cease using CFCs in its packaging.
exampleTranslation: Công ty quyết định ngừng sử dụng CFC trong bao bì.

definition: to make the effort to do something (bother + to-infinitive)
translation: chịu khó làm gì, bận tâm làm gì
exampleSentence: He didn't bother to answer the question.
exampleTranslation: Anh ta không buồn trả lời câu hỏi.

definition: to make the effort to do something (bother + -ing)
translation: chịu khó làm gì, bận tâm làm gì
exampleSentence: Many young people don't bother voting.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều người trẻ không buồn đi bỏ phiếu.

definition: to promise or agree to do something; formal (undertake + to-infinitive)
translation: cam kết làm gì, nhận làm gì
exampleSentence: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy cam kết trả lại tiền trong sáu tháng.

definition: to make a serious promise to yourself or someone else (vow + to-infinitive)
translation: thề làm gì, nguyện làm gì
exampleSentence: Supporters have vowed to continue the protest.
exampleTranslation: Những người ủng hộ thề sẽ tiếp tục cuộc biểu tình.

definition: used to say that you are very excited and eager to do something (can't wait + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I can't wait to tell Gloria the good news.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nóng lòng muốn báo tin vui cho Gloria.

definition: to make it possible or easier for someone to do something by doing part of the work (help + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: She came to help clean the machines.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đến giúp làm sạch các máy.

definition: to make it easier for someone to do something; the to is optional (help + somebody + infinitive with or without to)
exampleSentence: She helped him choose some new clothes.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy giúp anh ấy chọn quần áo mới.

definition: to make it easier for someone to do something by doing part of the work (help + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I helped her to carry her cases up the stairs.
exampleTranslation: Tôi giúp cô ấy xách vali lên cầu thang.

definition: to agree unwillingly that something is true (admit + -ing)
exampleSentence: Dana admitted feeling hurt by what I had said.
exampleTranslation: Dana thừa nhận đã bị tổn thương vì những gì tôi nói.

definition: to expect that something will happen and be ready for it; formal (anticipate + -ing)
translation: đoán trước là sẽ phải làm gì
exampleSentence: I didn't anticipate having to do the cooking myself.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không ngờ là mình sẽ phải tự nấu ăn.

definition: to prevent something bad from happening, or to stay away from doing it (avoid + -ing)
exampleSentence: The refugees left to avoid getting bombed.
exampleTranslation: Những người tị nạn rời đi để tránh bị ném bom.

definition: used to say that you cannot stop yourself behaving or feeling in a certain way (can't help + -ing)
exampleSentence: I can't help feeling that there has been a mistake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thể không cảm thấy có sự nhầm lẫn nào đó.

definition: used to say that you do not like something at all (can't stand + -ing)
translation: không chịu nổi việc làm gì
exampleSentence: Lily can't stand working in an office.
exampleTranslation: Lily không chịu nổi việc làm trong văn phòng.

definition: to be so upset about something that you cannot accept it (can't bear + -ing)
translation: không chịu nổi việc làm gì
exampleSentence: I couldn't bear not seeing him again.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không chịu nổi việc không được gặp lại anh ấy.

definition: to be so upset about something that you cannot accept it (can't bear + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I can't bear to see her cry.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không đành lòng nhìn cô ấy khóc.

definition: to think about something carefully, especially before making a decision (consider + -ing)
exampleSentence: I seriously considered resigning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã nghiêm túc cân nhắc việc từ chức.

definition: to think about something that you might do in the future (contemplate + -ing)
exampleSentence: Did you ever contemplate resigning?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đã bao giờ tính đến chuyện từ chức chưa?

definition: to wait until a later time to do something (delay + -ing)
exampleSentence: Big companies often delay paying their bills.
exampleTranslation: Các công ty lớn thường trì hoãn việc thanh toán hóa đơn.

definition: to say that you did not do something (deny + -ing)
exampleSentence: Two men have denied murdering a woman.
exampleTranslation: Hai người đàn ông đã phủ nhận việc giết một phụ nữ.

definition: to think that something is unpleasant and not like it (dislike + -ing)
exampleSentence: I dislike being the centre of attention.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thích trở thành tâm điểm chú ý.

definition: to get pleasure from doing something (enjoy + -ing)
exampleSentence: Young children enjoy helping around the house.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ nhỏ thích giúp việc trong nhà.

definition: to want to do something; often in questions and negatives; mainly British (fancy + -ing)
translation: muốn làm gì, có hứng làm gì
exampleSentence: Sorry, but I don't fancy going out tonight.
exampleTranslation: Xin lỗi, nhưng tối nay tôi không muốn ra ngoài.

definition: to want to do something (feel like + -ing)
translation: muốn làm gì, thấy có hứng làm gì
exampleSentence: He didn't feel like going to work.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy không muốn đi làm.

definition: to complete the last part of something you are doing (finish + -ing)
exampleSentence: I finished typing the report just minutes before it was due.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đánh máy xong báo cáo chỉ vài phút trước hạn nộp.

definition: to stop doing something, especially something you do regularly (give up + -ing)
translation: bỏ làm gì, từ bỏ việc làm gì
exampleSentence: I gave up going to the theatre when I moved out of London.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bỏ thói quen đi xem kịch khi chuyển khỏi London.

definition: to form a picture in your mind of yourself doing something (imagine + -ing)
exampleSentence: Imagine doing a horrible job like that!
exampleTranslation: Hãy tưởng tượng phải làm một công việc kinh khủng như thế!

definition: to form a picture in your mind of someone doing something (imagine + somebody + -ing)
translation: tưởng tượng ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: She could imagine dark-robed figures moving silently along the stone corridors.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy có thể tưởng tượng những bóng người áo choàng đen lặng lẽ đi dọc hành lang đá.

definition: if an activity involves something, that thing is a part or result of it (involve + -ing)
translation: bao gồm việc làm gì, đòi hỏi phải làm gì
exampleSentence: Running your own business usually involves working long hours.
exampleTranslation: Tự kinh doanh thường đòi hỏi phải làm việc nhiều giờ.

definition: to give an acceptable reason for something other people think is unreasonable (justify + -ing)
translation: biện minh cho việc làm gì
exampleSentence: How can we justify spending so much money on arms?
exampleTranslation: Làm sao chúng ta biện minh cho việc chi quá nhiều tiền vào vũ khí?

definition: to continue doing something, or to do the same thing many times (keep + -ing)
translation: cứ làm gì, liên tục làm gì
exampleSentence: I keep thinking about Joe, all alone in that place.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cứ nghĩ về Joe, một mình ở nơi đó.

definition: to make someone or something stay in a state of doing something (keep + somebody + -ing)
translation: giữ cho ai/cái gì tiếp tục làm gì
exampleSentence: Jane kept the engine running.
exampleTranslation: Jane để động cơ chạy liên tục.

definition: to continue doing something, or to do it many times (keep on + -ing)
exampleSentence: You just have to keep on trying.
exampleTranslation: Bạn chỉ cần cứ tiếp tục cố gắng.

definition: to feel annoyed or upset about something (mind + -ing)
translation: phiền khi làm gì, ngại làm gì
exampleSentence: Did you mind being away from home for so long?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có phiền khi xa nhà lâu như vậy không?

definition: to fail to do something, especially when you wanted to but could not (miss + -ing)
translation: suýt, lỡ mất việc làm gì
exampleSentence: He missed being elected by a single vote.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy trượt cuộc bầu cử chỉ vì thiếu một phiếu.

definition: to change the time of a planned action to a later one (postpone + -ing)
exampleSentence: They decided to postpone having a family for a while.
exampleTranslation: Họ quyết định hoãn việc sinh con một thời gian.

definition: to do an activity often to improve your skill (practise + -ing); American English spells it practice
exampleSentence: Today we're going to practise parking.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay chúng ta sẽ luyện tập đỗ xe.

definition: to delay doing something until a later time (put off + -ing)
exampleSentence: I put off going to the doctor, but I wish I hadn't.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cứ trì hoãn việc đi khám bác sĩ, nhưng giờ ước gì mình đã đi.
